s01.shot: city of seven towers at dawn, a small cowardly servant boy entering a grand guildhall among proud armored members

s02.shot: extreme close-up of a gray-green eye snapping open in shock, white-streaked hair strand visible

s03.shot: the servant boy mopping a vast guildhall floor, buckets and rags, looked down upon by passing members

s04.shot: seal festival ceremony in a golden hall, elders distributing glowing seals, the boy peeking from behind a door

s05.shot: a black iron cube with violet cracks flying out of an open chest toward the stunned boy, chains whipping

s06.shot: the boy's scarred hand reaching out and touching the floating black cube, spark of violet light

s07.shot: black flames engulfing the boy as a horrified crowd screams, guildhall interior burning with dark fire

s08.shot: morning: the boy walking out of gray ash unharmed, a living ash-dragon tattoo moving on his shoulder

s09.shot: the furious boy with glowing eyes as the tallest tower splits from top to bottom behind him, debris flying

s10.shot: terrified guild masters around a table, the golden-masked grandmaster standing, dread and panic

s11.shot: night council in a dark chamber, masked elders raising hands to vote, a full moon through a round window

s12.shot: the boy standing outside a window at night listening, faint smile, dragon tattoo glowing on his shoulder
